effect_description_eng:
＜Raid＞ (When this Digimon attacks, you may switch the target of attack to 1 of your opponent's unsuspended Digimon with the highest DP.)
[When Digivolving] If you have 1 or fewer Tamers, from your hand and without paying the cost, you may play 1 red or black Tamer card with a play cost of 4 or less or 1 Tamer card with the [CS] trait.
inherited_effect_description_eng: ＜Security A. +1＞ (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.)
xros_req: [Digivolve] Lv.4 w/[Greymon] in name or w/[CS] trait: Cost 3
